name: Haunted Mines
theme: Descend into the Haunted Mines to gather Cursed Skulls and summon a Grave Golem down your lane.
firstObjective: Warning at 2:30, opens at 3:00 (subsequent waves respawn 2:00 after both Grave Golems are defeated; mines remain open after opening)
spawnPattern: 4 Mine entrances above ground; underground features 8 Risen Miner camps (5 on top-right/bottom-left, 4 on top-left/bottom-right) and 1 central Grave Golem
bosses: 1 Underground Grave Golem (Center of the Mines)

mechanic.title: Underground Skulls & Grave Golems
mechanic.description: Teams enter the underground Mines through 4 Mine Shafts to defeat Risen Miners and the central Grave Golem for Cursed Skulls, which scale the power and durability of each team's laning Grave Golem. Skulls drop in fixed increments from Miners and from the central Golem at health thresholds and upon death, and once enough Skulls are gathered, a Grave Golem marches down each team's lane to siege structures.

camps.name: Sapper Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Located in the top and bottom side lanes. Pumpkin-throwing Sappers deal splash ranged attacks and charge structures to detonate for heavy damage if left unchecked.

camps.name: Bruisers / Knights (1 Central Camp)
camps.notes: Located in the central upper jungle between lanes. Durable melee mercenaries with a Spell Armor aura that push lanes and contest central map control.

strategy: Haunted Mines is a compact two-lane battleground where balancing Skull collection underground with aboveground lane soak and Sapper pressure often decides structural trades. Prioritize heroes with strong PvE clear, sustain, or global mobility (such as Sylvanas, Greymane, or Dehaka), clear high-yield Miner packs efficiently, and punish overextended Mine dives with Sapper pushes or lane pressure.
notes: Hero vision is reduced while inside the Mines, and Mine Shafts can be used for rotations or juking—watch for tunnel/entrance camps when rotating, and remember that pushing alongside a strong Grave Golem or timing a Siege/Sap push around Golem spawns maximizes structure damage.
